recorder.briefingIntro: A quick briefing before you roll. Read it once, then fly the camera.
recorder.unsupported: This browser cannot record a canvas to video. Chrome, Edge and Firefox on desktop all work.

filmed.title: What you see is what gets filmed
filmed.body: The globe is captured live, in one take. There is no re-render afterwards: the shot you fly is the shot you keep.

direct.title: You direct the camera while it plays
direct.body: In Orbit mode, drag to swing around the glider, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag to tilt. Chase, Cockpit and Top stay one click away and can be switched mid-take.

realTime.title: It runs in real time, then stops itself
realTime.body: The replay rewinds to launch, counts you in, and records until landing. Press Stop earlier whenever you have the shot. The file is saved either way.

recorder.panelsNotFilmed: The panels around the globe are not filmed. A compact altitude / vario / speed strip and a progress bar are burned into the video instead. Switch them off below for a clean picture.

formatHints.mp4: Plays everywhere: phones, social apps, video editors.
formatHints.webm: Smaller file at the same quality. Best for the web.

recorder.burnInHint: Altitude, vario, speed, clock and a progress bar.
recorder.tips: Sharpest results come from a big globe, so go fullscreen before you open this panel. Keep the tab in front, too: a background tab throttles the globe, and the video with it.
